claims.text: The study primarily analyzes tweets from users labeled as left, right, and news feed, but also incorporates additional data for better context.
The research emphasizes the importance of tweets, particularly through the construction of a User-to-Mentioned-User graph based on tweet mentions.
While the main focus is on tweets, the study acknowledges that using all available data improves the accuracy of the embeddings.
